description: Work one Derive options order from its own wallet for a better price than filling at once: take a maker who saves half the spread, rest at the mark, never past the worst price agreed.

INSTRUMENT.description: Derive's name for the option, from the quote: ETH-20261128-3000-P.

ACTION.description: open sells a cash-secured put (or a call the account covers), buy buys one, close sells back or buys back what the duty's account holds. A close is worked by RFQ and the book only: Derive refuses a resting reduce-only order.

SIZE.description: Contracts to trade, in units of the underlying, on the venue's size step.

WORST_PRICE.description: The worst price per contract, before fees, the owner agreed to: the fill-now price by default. A sale never goes under it, a buy never over it.

FEE_USD.description: The fill-now quote's fee_usd for the whole SIZE (Derive's plus the Virtuals platform fee). Turns a price per contract into the rail's net bound.

WORK_MINUTES.description: How long to work the order, from when its money is on Derive. It always finishes an hour before expiry.

STEP_MINUTES.description: How often the target gives ground toward the book, and the makers are asked again. Defaults to an eighth of WORK_MINUTES, between 1 and 30.

TAKE_SAVING.description: A maker's quote is taken at once when it saves this share of the gap between the book's price and Derive's mark. 1 takes a maker only at the target; 0 takes any quote that beats the book.

SIZE_STEP.description: The venue's size step for this option (the quote's size_step).

MIN_SIZE.description: The smallest order the venue takes (the quote's min_size). Less than this left over finishes the duty. Defaults to SIZE_STEP.

TICK_SIZE.description: Derive's price tick for this option (public/get_instrument tick_size): a resting order rests on it, and moves only by more than 1.5 ticks.

MAKER_FEE_RATE.description: Derive's maker fee for this option, a share of the index per contract (public/get_instrument maker_fee_rate). A resting fill pays it and no base fee; every choice between resting, asking the makers and taking the book is made on what the owner nets after fees.

FILL_NOW_PRICE.description: The book's price per contract when the owner agreed: the receipt compares the average with it. Defaults to WORST_PRICE.

STOP.description: true ends the order early: the duty cancels what rests on Derive, sends the receipt for what filled, and finishes. The only way to take a resting order off the book: the chat cannot cancel it, and a paused duty cannot.

status.busy: Waiting on its last order · check {next}
status.stopped: Stopped: the server refused its orders
